subject: Reproducible KMS provenance recipe and demo request
messages:
From: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@greenbank.com>
To: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai
Cc: audit-team@greenbank.com
Date: Tue, 9 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: Request: reproducible KMS provenance recipe and sample logs

Hi Vivek,

As part of GreenBank's SIG/SOC2 scoping, our auditors have asked for a reproducible "audit recipe" that lets us validate key provenance end-to-end for a sample tenant. Specifically we'd like: 
- a short step-by-step recipe (so an auditor can reproduce the steps) that shows key creation, wrapping/unwrapping flow, and rotation events;
- a manifest mapping artifact names to timestamps and HSM attestation IDs;
- annotated rotation logs where lines are correlated to operator IDs and shift windows.

Can your team provide a compact package and indicate whether you can run a quick 20–30 minute walkthrough (screen share) to demonstrate how artifacts map to runtime traces? Our timeline: SOC2 readiness checkpoint next Tuesday (2027-11-16).

Thanks — if you can share a target delivery ETA I will coordinate with our DPO and the audit scheduling team.

Regards,
Marta Ruiz
Senior IT Audit Manager
GreenBank

--
Marta Ruiz
GreenBank | Information Assurance

From: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai
To: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@greenbank.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 9 Nov 2027 17:28:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Request: reproducible KMS provenance recipe and sample logs

Marta — thanks for the clear list. We can provide a reproducible audit recipe plus the requested artifacts. High level plan and ETA: 

1) By 2027-11-10 EOD UTC: deliver a compact package containing:
   - repro-audit-recipe.md (playbook with commands and expected outputs)
   - kms-provenance-manifest.csv (artifact -> attestation id -> timestamp)
   - rotation-annotated.log (sample operator-shift correlation, redacted PII)

2) By 2027-11-12: schedule a 25-minute screencast + live Q&A to walk the auditor through the recipe and show how to validate hashes/attestations.

Notes on contents: the recipe will use a retained sample tenant (non-prod) so nothing from production data is exposed. HSM attestation IDs will be the real attestation references; we will include verification commands and the expected JSON output for reproducibility. We will also include checksums for every artifact and a short script to recompute them.

Attachments included in this email: repro-audit-recipe.md; kms-provenance-manifest.csv; rotation-annotated.log (see attachment stubs below).

Let us know preferred windows for the demo (we propose 2027-11-11 14:00–16:00 UTC or 2027-11-12 09:00–11:00 UTC).

Thanks,
Vivek

--
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Infrastructure & Security Engineering
Redwood Inference

From: marissa.cole@redwood.ai
To: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai, hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 10 Nov 2027 08:05:00 +0000
Subject: Fwd: Request: reproducible KMS provenance recipe and sample logs

Vivek / Hannah — quick add: when you produce rotation-annotated.log please include the operator shift roster mapping (shift id -> operator email) and the minimal ACL snapshot that applies to the sample tenant at the time of the rotation events. Auditors often ask for both the operator identity and the policy that governed their access. 

I also recommend we include a short section in the recipe describing how to verify that wrapped keys were derived under the expected KEK policy (link to internal runbook). I'll attach the runbook excerpt for the demo.

Marissa
Senior Compliance Engineer
Redwood Inference

Thanks Vivek and Marissa — that timeline works. We'll take the 2027-11-12 09:00–09:30 UTC slot for the walkthrough; please send a calendar invite to audit-team@greenbank.com.

A few clarifying asks before the demo: 
- please redact any endpoint IPs in rotation-annotated.log that are part of your infra internal VPCs; preserve operator IDs and attestation references;
- include the checksum script as an executable snippet in the recipe (so auditors can run it locally);
- provide a one-paragraph statement confirming that the sample tenant's keys are not used for production workloads (legal requirement for our scope).

If you can attach the package to the Drive link you provided we will fetch it and run an initial reproducibility check before the walkthrough.

Regards,
Marta Ruiz
Senior IT Audit Manager
GreenBank
